notes: Built from Hamilton's official straight-on render (the supplied photo is angled; it is kept as the 3/4 reference).

Modelled: bronze bezel with a scalloped grip edge, glossy black insert with its beige triangle, numerals and bars as traced inlays, bronze case and lugs from the outline, bronze hour hand with the lume bulb and minute hand with lume, small seconds hand, large fluted crown at 3, dark brown leather strap with the house curl.
From the photo map: grained black dial, beige numerals, railway track, Hamilton logo, Mechanical, the small seconds ring, Swiss Made; the strap leather and stitching.
The hour hand's tip covers part of the 0 of 10 in the render; that 0 is drawn again. Bronze colours are taken from the render. Heights are estimated (no side photo).
